inputs.text: Square premium advertising photograph: a clean white box truck with its rear ramp down parked at the curb of a sunny South Florida home, two professional movers in plain deep-navy t-shirts loading a cream-colored armchair and neatly stacked moving boxes into the truck, bright late-morning sunlight, lush palm trees and tropical landscaping behind them, deep navy-blue shadow tones, warm cream highlights, a single red-orange accent stripe along the truck's lower trim, crisp photorealistic detail, 35mm commercial photography, premium brand campaign aesthetic, generous negative space of smooth pavement in the lower quarter of the frame, no text, no logos, no lettering.
